request.instructions: Illustrative clean-energy briefing, not real investment data. Use rabitmoon dark, orange primary and teal secondary. One focal visual per page, readable labels, generous margins and morph transitions. No generated images.

pages.title: How a solar system works

raw_data.message: Panels convert sunlight to electricity; an inverter supplies usable AC power.

pages.instructions: Headline at top; large lucide:sun and three labelled native shapes for panel, inverter and home; takeaway at bottom.

pages.title: From sunlight to a home
pages.diagram: Mermaid flowchart TB. Rounded terminal for sunlight, rectangles for panel and inverter, rounded home terminal. Directed labelled arrows; one clear vertical chain.
pages.instructions: Diagram occupies the middle two thirds; keep all labels readable on portrait canvas.

pages.title: Illustrative output by quarter
pages.instructions: One orange bar chart, zero baseline, direct value labels, kWh axis. Clearly label the data as illustrative.

pages.title: Where each component fits
pages.instructions: A three-row table plus simple Iconify symbols; do not invent specifications or costs.

pages.title: Three things to remember
raw_data: An inverter converts DC to usable AC.
Storage is optional and depends on the system.
